provider: Emergent Ventures (Mercatus Center) - 13+, worldwide, no institution, fastest individual grant

free_tier.stated: Open-budget microgrant: no fixed cap. Third-party trackers report a $1k-$50k typical range and up to $100k over two years, but the programme itself publishes no range - budgets are evaluated case by case. Rolling applications, one 1,500-word proposal, occasional 10-15 minute interview.

chaining: Dedicated tranches (Africa/Caribbean, India, UK Dynamism, Ukraine, Archaeology, Travel for Career Development, US Science Policy) each have their own budget, so a project can be aimed at the tranche where it fits best.

limits.value: applications, one 1,500-word proposal, occasional 10-15 minute interview

limits_note: Applicants must be at least 13 years old; one application per applicant per project. AI-written applications are now rejected outright ('We will test all submissions and reject those using AI for anything other than proofreading') - relevant given how this research was produced.
reliability_note: One-time or slightly staggered payments; no reporting burden. The realistic ceiling for a storage project is a few thousand dollars, i.e. tens of TB-months - enough to self-fund a year of Hetzner, not a decade.
